warnings: This drawing set prints NO grid bubbles (structural or architectural) — only dimension chains. Labels were assigned here following the precedent of houses 122/129 (other unlabelled สพฐ. sets): numbers 1-10 on the ten column lines along x (9 bays x 4.00 = 36.00, left to right as drawn on the foundation plan, stage end = grid 1), letters on the column rows along y with A at the top of the plan as drawn. Origin A1 (top-left).

Rows: A (0.00) and E (21.00) are the long walls (F1C1 / F3C3), B (7.00) and D (14.00) are the end-wall column rows (F3C3 on grids 1 and 10, F2C2 at the stage on grid 2), C (10.50) is the row of seven interior F2C2 short columns under the G3 ground beams (grids 3-9) and the ridge line. All five carry columns, so all five are named lines, not dummies (same reasoning as house 129).

Row C (10.50) is not dimensioned on the foundation plan itself; its position is printed twice elsewhere — the porch-canopy chain 3.50 + 3.50 between rows B and D on the roof beam plan, and the truss-A panel chain 1.05 x 10 from row A to the ridge on the cross-section — and the F2C2 marks on the foundation plan measure 10.50 by scale. Three sources agree.

Stage geometry (grid 1-2, B4 front edge): the foundation plan prints the x chain 1.00 | .65 from grid 2 (2' 5.00, 2'' 5.65) and the y chain 2.00 | 1.00 from row D (D' 16.00, D''' 17.00) for the LOWER chamfer only. The upper chamfer is drawn symmetric; its lines A'''' 4.00 (also printed on the floor plan as 3.00 + 1.00) and A'''''' 5.00 (not printed anywhere — position by symmetry, confirmed by scale 5.03) carry the B4 endpoints; A'''''' has its own lowered score. Measured by scale the drawn front edge sits ~1.8 m from grid 2, not 1.65 — the printed .65 is taken (printed value wins).

Before-origin dummies share the first main line's prime sequence (section 4): x 1' -2.00 (roof edge), 1'' -1.00 (door landing); y A' -3.00 (roof edge), A'' -2.00 (canopy B7 / walkway edge), then A''' 3.00, A'''' 4.00, A''''' 4.50, A'''''' 5.00 in the A-B gap.

z: the cross-section prints only 0.35 / 3.50 / 2.50 up the left side (ground -> floor +0.35 -> B8/canopy +3.85 -> truss bearing +6.35); the top segment to the ridge carries a tick but no number and was not recorded. Labelled levels come from the floor plan (+0.175, +0.35, +1.20) and the sections (ระดับพื้นดิน / ระดับดินเดิม, ระดับพื้นเวที).

Conflict: the stage detail (ขยายเวที 1:20) labels its bottom line '∇ ระดับ ±0.00' with a 0.175 + 0.85 chain above it, which would put the stage at +1.025; the floor plan prints the stage at +1.20 and the hall at +0.35. Taken: the chain spans +0.175 -> +0.35 -> +1.20 (0.85 = 1.20 - 0.35, 0.175 = 0.35 - 0.175 exactly), i.e. the detail's ±0.00 is a local floor reference. Two labelled sheets vs one local label; the alternative reading is plausible, so the chain carries a note.

Element-internal dimensions are kept on the elements, not here (section 4 rule 4 exception): footing plan sizes/pile spacing and the 0.10/0.30/0.10/0.10 thickness chains, beam/column/slab section sizes, the truss-A panel spacing 1.05 x 10 (put on truss A in the sheet-2 section file), the truss-B depth 0.87.

Dimension sweep covers the structural sheet 3 (page 04: foundation plan, roof beam plan, details), sheet 2 (page 03: cross-section, longitudinal section, roof/stage details) and sheet 1 (page 02: floor plan, elevations — the three elevations print no dimensions). Page 05 (furniture / ครุภัณฑ์ details) is not part of the building and was not swept. Page 01 is the sharer cover.
Scanned set (ปรับปรุงปี 2530/2542); the sheet-3 label at A1 prints 'F303' — read as F3C3 (every other corner/end-wall mark on the same plan reads F3C3).
